description_en: Upgrades the database version of an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 升级MongoDB实例的数据库版本
name: UpgradeDBInstanceEngineVersion

parameters.description_en:
The database version to which you want to upgrade. Valid values: **3.4**, **4.0**, and **4.2**.

> This database version must be later than the current database version of the instance.
parameters.description_zh:
升级的目标数据库版本。

> 实例的存储引擎对数据库版本的选择有约束性，详情请参见[MongoDB数据库版本升级说明](~~398673~~)，您也可以调用[DescribeAvailableEngineVersion](~~468471~~)接口查询实例可升级的版本。
parameters.help_en:
The database version to which you want to upgrade. Valid values: **3.4**, **4.0**, and **4.2**.

parameters.help_zh:

> 实例的存储引擎对数据库版本的选择有约束性，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/398673.html，您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/468471.html接口查询实例可升级的版本
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.description_en:
The time when to perform the upgrade. Valid values:

- **0**: immediately performs the upgrade.

- **1**: performs the upgrade during the maintenance window.
parameters.description_zh:
实例版本升级模式。取值：

- 0：立即升级。
- 1：在可运维时间段内升级。
